items.summary: The decision to boost guidance was driven by growth in the semiconductor company’s data-center business, Chief Executive Officer Matt Murphy said.

items.title: Marvell Shares Slide After Hours
items.summary: Shares fell almost 6% in after-hours trading for semiconductor company Marvell Technology after the its second-quarter earnings met analyst projections, but didn’t blow them out of the water. Stripping out certain one-time items, adjusted earnings were 94 cents a share, narrowly beating the 93 cents expected by analysts polled by FactSet.
